en.confirm.body: This installs @deepseek-ai/dsh {version} (currently {installed}). A rollback snapshot of the current version is taken automatically first.
en.confirm.downgradeBody: This downgrades @deepseek-ai/dsh to {version} (currently {installed}). A rollback snapshot is taken automatically first.
en.confirm.impact: The operation rewrites this machine's global npm package; afterwards the dsh host process restarts and this page reloads.
en.confirm.title: Confirm install
en.diagnostics.empty: No restart log is available yet.
en.diagnostics.hint: Read the restart log on demand (up to 16 KiB / 100 lines), with common credentials redacted. Review local paths and other details before sharing.
en.diagnostics.title: Restart diagnostics
en.diagnostics.truncated: Only the log tail is shown.
en.history.title: Recent activity
en.notMounted: Host routes not mounted: the plugin is installed, but dsh web needs one restart to serve them.
en.operations.hint: Latest 200 events in this host run; read on checks, settlement, or manual refresh. Installs record outcomes only.
en.operations.title: Activity timeline
en.pending.hint: Waiting for the execution window or a free install slot. Cancelling clears only this wait, not the policy or daily check; later automatic checks may schedule an update again.
en.pending.title: Waiting to auto-install
en.policy.checkAt.hint: Run one background check every day at this time. Empty disables the schedule, but auto mode still checks once after each start.
en.policy.checkAt.label: Daily check at
en.policy.mode.hint.auto: Found versions install automatically and restart per the setting below.
en.policy.mode.hint.notify: Highlight discoveries in the panel; installs stay manual.
en.policy.mode.hint.off: Only surface updates in the panel; nothing runs on its own.
en.policy.mode.label: Automation
en.policy.restart.fixed: Nothing restarts on its own; press "Restart now" on this panel to hand the port over.
en.policy.restart.label: After install
en.policy.title: Update policy
en.policy.track.hint.line: Accept only stable releases within a caret/tilde line (e.g. ^0.4.0 — newest 0.4.x).
en.policy.track.hint.pin: Track nothing; only an explicit choice changes the version.
en.policy.track.hint.tag: Always follow what the chosen dist-tag points at.
en.policy.track.label: Tracking
en.policy.window.hint: Applies to silent auto-update: automatic installs may only START inside this local time span. Empty means anytime. Equal bounds mean all day; end before start wraps past midnight.
en.policy.window.label: Execution window
en.preflight.advisory: Advisory only; does not block installation or guarantee success.
en.preflight.failed: Preflight unavailable; check host routes or try again later.
en.preflight.title: Update preflight
en.progress.phase.snapshot: Backing up the current version (rollback snapshot)
en.publishFailed: Could not read the registry: {error}. Local facts remain valid.
en.publishUnknown: Release information could not be read: whether an update exists is unknown.
en.restart.failed: Restart failed: {error}. Stop and start dsh web yourself.
en.restart.pending: Handing the port over and exiting the old process…
en.restart.staleBody: Disk holds {installed} while the running process is {running}. Restarting activates the new version and refreshes this page's assets.
en.restart.timeout: Timed out waiting for the replacement ({version}). Check the terminal, or run dsh web again.
en.restart.title: Restart the dsh host
en.restart.unavailable: A restart is required (disk {installed}/running {running}), but this environment cannot restart automatically — please do it from a terminal.
en.restart.waiting: Old process exited; waiting for the replacement ({version})…
en.restoreConfirm.body: This restores @deepseek-ai/dsh to {version} from the local snapshot. No network is needed, but the whole installation tree is copied back, which can take a minute or two for a large tree. The version being replaced is kept as a snapshot first, so this step can be undone.
en.restoreConfirm.impact: Restoring overwrites the installation currently on disk; a host restart is required afterwards.
en.restoreConfirm.title: Confirm snapshot restore
en.snapshots.empty: No snapshots yet. One appears here after the first install or manual update.
en.snapshots.hint: Every install backs up the previous version first, and a restore keeps the version it replaces. Restoring needs no network, but copies the whole tree back — a large one takes a minute or two.
en.snapshots.restoring: Restoring {version}: the whole installation tree is being copied back. Keep this page open.
en.snapshots.title: Snapshots & rollback
en.source.hint: Which registry the install fetches from. Pick the mirror when the official one is slow or timing out; "automatic" follows whichever registry served the version list.
en.source.label: Download source
en.task.slow: No movement for {time} — the download source is probably slow. This run is not interrupted (stopping npm mid-reify corrupts the tree); once it settles, retry from the mirror.
en.task.title: Install task
en.title: Current installation
en.tree.leftovers: {count} retired directories left by an interrupted npm install are still in the tree, holding disk and resolution paths.
en.tree.missingLauncher: No launcher entry (lib/bin.js) could be read in {dir}: that install only wrote half of itself. Restore a snapshot from above, or install again.
en.tree.missingManifest: No package.json for dsh could be read in {dir}: the global tree may have been left half-committed by an interrupted install. Restore a snapshot from above, or reinstall from a terminal.
en.tree.restored: The tree was found incomplete at startup and has been rebuilt in place from the snapshot of {version}.
en.tree.title: Installation tree health
en.versions.title: Available versions
